_readme: Single source of truth for the words that travel WITH each post: the caption typed into the
channel, and the alt text posted alongside it. The words set ON each creative are not here;
they are read straight out of asset-renderer.html by build-where-is-pi-pack.mjs, so what the
review page shows as on-tile copy is literally what the renderer draws.
Rules that apply to everything in this file, enforced by check-where-is-pi.mjs:
- No Case 01 solution: no Cape Schanck, Main Ridge, Red Hill or Montalto, and none of the
witness tells that resolve them. Mornington is allowed; the game's title card gives it away.
- No em-dashes, no exclamation marks, no tourism adjectives.
- The prize sentence and the URL are quoted from creative-provenance.json and must match it.

posts.caption:

Case 01 of Where in the Peninsula is PI? is open. Four towns, one Insider, and a sun that only moves when you do.

Ask the witnesses. Search the scene. Read the land. Catch her before last light and she will tell you what to order.
